question: In which of the following Articles of India is it mentioned that “it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to cherish and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**51(b)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The duty of Indian citizens to follow the ideals that inspired the country's struggle fo**r freedom is mentioned in Article 51A(b)** of the Constitution of India.
 
• This article is **part of the Fundamental Duties of the Constitution. **
 
• **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution lays down the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
• It was **added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976,** and it specifies various duties that every citizen is expected to follow to promote the welfare of the nation​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the key duties mentioned in this article include:
 
 
• **Article 51A (a)**: To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag, and the National Anthem.
 
• **Article 51A (c)**: To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India.
 
• **Article 51A (d)**: To defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so.
 
• **Article 51A (e)**: To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India, transcending religious, linguistic, and regional or sectional diversities.
 
• **Article 51A (f)**: To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture.
 
• **Article 51A (g)**: To protect and improve the natural environment, including forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife, and to have compassion for living creatures.
 
• **Article 51A (h)**: To develop the scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
 
• **Article 51A (i)**: To safeguard public property and to abjure violence.
 
• **Article 51A (j)**: To strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavor and achievement.
